facts.text: The Sonnenalp Hotel is located in the heart of Vail Village.
facts.excerpt: Sonnenalp is located in the heart of Vail Village, one of Colorado's most iconic mountain destinations.

facts.text: All suites and hotel rooms have a view of either Gore Creek or Vail Village.
facts.excerpt: all with a view of either Gore Creek or Vail Village

facts.text: Each suite has a bedroom and a living room area.
facts.excerpt: Each suite has a bedroom and a well-appointed, delightfully comfortable living room area.

facts.text: Many suites feature gas fireplaces, balconies and heated marble bathroom floors.
facts.excerpt: Many suites feature separate living areas, gas fireplaces, balconies, heated marble bathroom floors, and views of Gore Creek or Vail Village.

facts.text: The hotel grew from a modest lodge its founders established 40 years ago.
facts.excerpt: The modest lodge our founders established 40 years ago led to the luxury hotel and resort that rests at the heart of Vail Valley today

facts.text: Swiss Chalet serves Swiss cuisine including fondue, raclette and schnitzel.
facts.excerpt: Swiss Chalet at Sonnenalp offers authentic Swiss cuisine including fondue, raclette, schnitzel, and alpine specialties inspired by traditional European recipes.

facts.text: Swiss Chalet reflects Sonnenalp's Bavarian heritage.
facts.excerpt: The restaurant reflects Sonnenalp's Bavarian heritage

facts.text: Breakfast is served on Ludwig's glass-enclosed terrace overlooking Gore Creek.
facts.excerpt: Sonnenalp's bountiful European style breakfast is served on the beautiful glass enclosed Ludwig’s terrace overlooking Gore Creek.

facts.text: Breakfast at Ludwig's offers a full menu, a hot and cold buffet and traditional pastries.
facts.excerpt: daily breakfast in Ludwig’s featuring a full menu as well as a tempting hot and cold buffet and a large selection of traditional pastries

facts.text: King's Club serves cocktails with live entertainment beside a fireplace.
facts.excerpt: Savor exquisite cocktails accompanied by live entertainment, all set against the backdrop of a roaring fireplace.

facts.text: Bully Ranch is a casual restaurant with Western charm serving Colorado-inspired dishes and burgers.
facts.excerpt: Bully Ranch offers indoor and outdoor dining along with a menu featuring Colorado-inspired dishes, burgers, salads, and signature specialties.

facts.text: The spa has a heated indoor and outdoor pool with a riverfront sun deck and a summer pool bar.
facts.excerpt: Heated indoor & outdoor tranquility pool with riverfront sun deck and summer pool bar.

facts.text: Indoor and outdoor whirlpools look out over Gore Creek.
facts.excerpt: Indoor and outdoor co-ed whirlpools offering the best views of the Gore creek.

facts.text: The spa has a cafe and an oxygen bar.
facts.excerpt: Spa Cafe & Oxygen Bar

facts.text: Steam rooms, saunas and the fitness center are for adults only; guests under 16 may use the pools with an adult.
facts.excerpt: hotel guests under 16 years old may use the Spa indoor and outdoor pool areas, when accompanied by an adult. Steam rooms, saunas, showers, and fitness center are available for adults only.

facts.text: The hotel has a Kids Club with arts and crafts and outdoor excursions.
facts.excerpt: From engaging arts and crafts sessions to exhilarating outdoor excursions, children are immersed in experiences that are both educational and fun.

facts.text: Hotel guests have preferred access to tee times at the Sonnenalp Club golf course.
facts.excerpt: Sonnenalp hotel guests have preferred access to golf tee times.

facts.text: The Sonnenalp Club golf course is in Edwards, 16 miles west of Vail Village.
facts.excerpt: The Sonnenalp Club is perfectly located in the sun drenched valley of Edwards, 16 miles west of Vail Village.

facts.text: The golf course is a 7,100-yard championship links-style course.
facts.excerpt: The Sonnenalp Golf Club is a championship, 7,100-yard links-style course

facts.text: The golf season runs from early April to late October.
facts.excerpt: This down valley location gives our members and guests an extended playing season stretching from early April to late October.

facts.text: The Sonnenalp Ski Concierge has a private lounge with secure lockers at Gorsuch Ski Cafe.
facts.excerpt: The Sonnenalp Hotel proudly offers our exclusive Sonnenalp Ski Concierge, boasting a private lounge, secure lockers and personalized service located at Gorsuch Ski Café.

facts.text: Gorsuch Ski Cafe is 50 steps from Gondola One.
facts.excerpt: in a private setting just 50 steps from Gondola One

facts.text: The ski concierge offers ski, snowboard and helmet rentals and demos through Gorsuch.
facts.excerpt: the Sonnenalp Ski Concierge has partnered with the experts at Gorsuch to provide top of the line rentals and demos for skis, snowboards and helmets

facts.text: Sonnenalp guides lead guided hikes and nature walks in summer.
facts.excerpt: Our professionally guided walks & hikes are uplifting, informative, surprisingly relaxing and provide just the right amount of challenge for any skill level.

facts.text: Guided winter hiking and snowshoeing tours are offered for ages 13 and up, with private tours for all ages.
facts.excerpt: Ages 13+ (Private tours available for all ages)

facts.text: Summer guided activities run through August 31.
facts.excerpt: summer activities run through August 31.

facts.text: Guests can explore Vail Village without needing to drive.
facts.excerpt: The ability to experience Vail without needing to drive is one of the unique advantages of staying at Sonnenalp

facts.text: The hotel calls itself one of the best places to stay in Vail.
facts.excerpt: It is regarded as one of the best places to stay in Vail and among the select award-winning luxury hotels in the Rocky Mountains.

facts.text: The golf course is described as both semi-private and private.
facts.excerpt: our semi-private, championship links-style golf course

facts.text: The golf course is private.
facts.excerpt: Challenge yourself on our private, 7,100-yard championship links-style golf course.

contradictions.note: p6 and p7 call the course semi-private; p8 calls it private

sources.excerpt: our semi-private, championship links-style golf course
Challenge yourself on our private, 7,100-yard championship links-style golf course.
